title: THE FEED WAITS FOR THE DEMO CONTROLS CARD
why: The HUD spec of 2026-10-15 (section 3.4): the DEMO controls card (shown while the spawn shield is up and for 4 seconds after) stands at the left, centred on the screen height and about 440 pixels tall at 1080p, which is where the ten feed lines are, so the two drew on top of each other at every drop in. The card has the place first now: while it is up the feed waits (its lines are kept and appear when the card fades).
now: The feed now waits while the DEMO controls card is up, so the two no longer overlap.
